hebrewText: וַ/תְּפוּצֶ֖ינָה מִ/בְּלִ֣י רֹעֶ֑ה וַ/תִּהְיֶ֧ינָה לְ/אָכְלָ֛ה לְ/כָל חַיַּ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה וַ/תְּפוּצֶֽינָה

tokens.bdb: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse)
tokens.kjv: break (dash, shake) in (to) pieces, cast (abroad), disperse (selves), drive, retire, scatter (abroad), spread abroad.

tokens.bdb: properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.
tokens.kjv: corruption, ig(norantly), for lack of, where no...is, so that no, none, not, un(awares), without.

tokens.bdb: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] break, companion, keep company with, devour, eat up, evil entreat, feed, use as a friend, make friendship with, herdman, keep (sheep) (-er), pastor, [phrase] shearing house, shepherd, wander, waste.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.explanation: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.explanationEn: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
tokens.kjv: [phrase] age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life(-time), live(-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance, [phrase] merry, multitude, [phrase] (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop.
country, field, ground, land, soil, [idiom] wild.

tokens.bdb: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse)
tokens.kjv: break (dash, shake) in (to) pieces, cast (abroad), disperse (selves), drive, retire, scatter (abroad), spread abroad.
